findingDetails.title: A node flag with a space-separated value is read as the script word, so a working hook is reported missing
findingDetails.scopeProof: NODE_FLAGS_WITH_ARGUMENT at :222-224 is the only table consulted by the two-word advance at :277; no other branch skips a flag value.
findingDetails.case: Hook command "node --env-file vars .skilled/skills/system-spec-kit/runtime/dist/hooks/claude/user-prompt-submit.js" prints "hook-missing claude .claude/settings.json" and exits 1, while node --env-file vars -e "console.log(1)" runs (ENVFILE_SPACED_RAN) and the equals form reports ok.
findingDetails.claim: --env-file takes a separate argument and is missing from NODE_FLAGS_WITH_ARGUMENT, so its value is read as the script word and a wired hook is reported missing.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Ran the equals form and the plain launch; both report ok. Verified node accepts the spaced form with -e. Read every branch of runsNodeOnMarker.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The table may be deliberately limited to installer-shaped flags. Rejected: the comment states the listed flags are value-taking, and a valid node flag with a separate value is the same class.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: Withdraw if the check declares only the installer flag set in scope and node-flag coverage is out of contract.

findingDetails.title: A command that starts after a shell keyword or the command builtin is not read as a command start
findingDetails.scopeProof: COMMAND_PREFIXES at :240 is the only prefix list; commandWords at :256-268 is its only consumer.
findingDetails.case: Hook command "if [ -f vars ]; then node <marker>; fi" and "command node <marker>" both print "hook-missing claude" and exit 1, while bash -c "if [ -f vars ]; then echo IF_THEN_RAN; fi" prints IF_THEN_RAN and command node -e "console.log(1)" prints COMMAND_NODE_RAN.
findingDetails.claim: simpleCommands splits only at separators and commandWords strips only { and exec, so a guarded or command-builtin launch is read with the keyword as its first word and reported missing.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Ran both forms through bash to prove they launch the command; read the prefix list and the command-start rule in the runsMarker comment.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: A compound if may be considered an exotic shell construct under settled decision 2. Rejected for the command builtin, which is a single word in the same family as the already-stripped exec.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: Withdraw the if/then half if compound commands are declared out of the wiring heuristic scope; the command-builtin half stands.

spec_code.notes: Fix claim for attached flag values verified by probes; incomplete value-taking flag table recorded as HC3-P2-001.
